# Pertsig

PertSig – a data-driven collection of transcriptional perturbation
signatures for human and mouse

The `pertsig` R package loads the signatures and turns them into gene
sets for enrichment analysis with
[fgsea](https://bioconductor.org/packages/fgsea/).

## Data

The signatures are available on Zenodo:
**<https://zenodo.org/records/23986547>**

| Species       | Signatures | Genes |
|---------------|-----------:|------:|
| Human (`hsa`) |        165 | 9,733 |
| Mouse (`mmu`) |        266 | 9,625 |

You can get the data in two ways:

- **Download the files** from the Zenodo record and use them with any
  tool.
- **Load them in R with this package.**
  [`loadSignatures()`](https://alserglab.github.io/pertsig/reference/loadSignatures.md)
  downloads the file on the first call and reads it from the local cache
  afterwards.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("alserglab/pertsig")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(pertsig)
library(fgsea)

signatures <- loadSignatures("mmu", geneId = "entrez")  # or "hsa", geneId = "symbol"

data(exampleRanks)
geneSets <- getGeneSets(signatures, topK = 200, universe = names(exampleRanks))
fgsea(geneSets, exampleRanks)
```

See the
[tutorial](https://alserglab.github.io/pertsig/articles/pertsig-tutorial.html)
for a full example.

## Citation

Nugmanova, A., & Sergushichev, A. (2026). PertSig—a data-driven
collection of transcriptional perturbation signatures for human and
mouse \[Dataset\]. Zenodo. <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23986547>

# Package index

## Loading signatures

- [`loadSignatures()`](https://alserglab.github.io/pertsig/reference/loadSignatures.md)
  : Load perturbation signatures

## Gene sets

- [`getGeneSets()`](https://alserglab.github.io/pertsig/reference/getGeneSets.md)
  : Convert signatures to gene sets
